speciesDecision.reason: DNR identifies the core four at exact named city piers and county pier-mode harvest supports recurrence. Repeated summer perch reports establish a real lead in Racine and Kenosha, but the published monthly pier table combines Lake Michigan and Green Bay and cannot support defensible city-level year-round magnitudes; the current Lake Michigan perch closure also requires species-specific gating not present in the expansion cohort.

evidence.title: Lake Michigan Creel Harvest Tables 1998–2024
supports: annual county-by-mode recurrence for the four salmonids

evidence.limitations: Harvest is estimated, not catch; annual values do not assign month, effort, exact structure, or absence. A zero estimate is not proof of biological absence.
